what: an acid blob: a single knee-high mound of thick, glistening, half-transparent slime with a rounded top, no face, no eyes and no limbs. Inside the slime float a few half-dissolved things: a pitted iron helmet and two small bones.
colours: acid yellow-green slime with a bright lime highlight on top and a darker olive base, a rust-brown pitted helmet and ivory bones inside it.
wears: It is an ooze and wears nothing.
holds: It has no hands and holds nothing; the helmet and bones are sunk inside its body.
pose: It rears up on one side like a wave about to fall, one thick blunt lobe of slime stretched forward and upward to engulf, a few fat drops falling from that lobe. It is one solid lump with a clean lower edge.
must_show: one mound of yellow-green slime
see-through body with a helmet or bones sunk inside
a thick lobe reaching forward
no face

what: a grid bug: a tiny magical creature the size of a hand, not a real insect. Its body is one flat, hard, glossy square plate with rounded corners, like a small floor tile, with two tiny round yellow eyes near the front edge. It has exactly four short, thick, straight legs and no more: one sticks straight out from the middle of each of the four sides of the square, so the whole creature makes a plus sign or a cross. It has no antennae.
colours: glossy violet-purple shell with a darker purple edge, bright yellow eyes, small bright yellow-white sparks.
wears: It is an insect and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from directly above, perfectly flat and symmetrical: the square body in the centre, one leg pointing straight up the picture, one straight down, one straight left and one straight right. A small yellow-white spark sits on the tip of each of the four legs, touching it.
must_show: a flat square purple body seen from above
exactly four straight legs, one per side, making a plus shape
small yellow sparks at the leg tips
tiny and harmless-looking
must_not_show: grid lines or floor tiles under it

what: a piercer: a cave snail whose shell is a real stalactite. The shell is a long, narrow, solid spike of rough, lumpy, dripping-wet cave rock with uneven bumps and ridges, as long as a man's arm, thick and broken-off at the top and narrowing to a sharp point at the bottom. The top is solid rough rock, closed, not hollow. From a small hole in the side of the rock near the top pokes the snail's little head: a short pale neck with two long eye-stalks, each tipped with a small black eye, bending down to look below.
colours: rough grey and grey-brown cave rock with darker cracks and a few pale mineral streaks, a small pale cream-yellow snail head and eye-stalks, black eyes.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It has no hands and holds nothing.
pose: It is falling point first: the rock spike hangs upright in the middle of the picture with the sharp tip at the bottom, the little snail head sticking out sideways to the left near the top, alone in empty space with no ceiling above it and nothing below it.
must_show: a rough stalactite of cave rock, point straight down
a small snail head with two eye-stalks poking out near the top
solid closed rock top, nothing sitting on it
nothing above or below it
must_not_show: cup or vase with an open rim
cream or blob sitting on top

what: a rust monster: a four-legged animal the size of a large dog, built like an armadillo, with a humped back covered in overlapping bony plates, a small pointed beaked head, and two very long, thick, feathery feelers like a moth's antennae sweeping forward from its face. Its long plated tail ends in a flat paddle with two blades, like a small propeller.
colours: rust-orange and red-brown armour plates, a pale tan belly and legs, cream feathery feelers, small black eyes.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it scuttles to the left on four short legs with its head low and both long feelers stretched far out ahead of it, reaching, tail raised behind.
must_show: four-legged armadillo-like body with armour plates
two long feathery feelers reaching forward
tail ending in a two-bladed paddle
rust-orange colour
must_not_show: sword or armour pieces lying nearby

what: a floating eye: one single enormous eyeball as big as a shield, a smooth round ball that hangs in the air with nothing else attached. The front is a glossy white eye with a huge round iris and a wide black pupil staring straight at the viewer; the back of the ball is wrapped in a thick, wrinkled, leathery rind like an eyelid pulled back.
colours: glossy white eyeball with thin red veins, a bright sky-blue iris with a paler ring, a black pupil, a dusky grey-blue leathery rind.
wears: It is a bare eyeball and wears nothing.
holds: It has no limbs and holds nothing.
pose: It floats in the middle of the picture, turned a little to the left, staring wide open and unblinking. It simply floats: nothing above it and nothing below it.
must_show: one single huge eyeball, a clean round ball
big blue iris and black pupil
leathery rind round the back
no limbs and no mouth

what: an intellect devourer: a bare, wrinkled brain the size of a hound that walks on four legs. The whole body is the brain: a big oval lump covered in deep folds and grooves, with no head, no face, no eyes and no tail. Four short, muscular, hairless legs like a bulldog's grow straight out of its underside, each ending in three large hooked claws.
colours: glistening pale pink and rose-tan brain with darker red-brown grooves, legs of the same pinkish-tan flesh, ivory claws.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It walks on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it trots to the left on four legs, body low and leaning forward, one front paw lifted with its claws spread.
must_show: the body is a wrinkled brain
four clawed legs, like a walking animal
no head and no face
pink-tan flesh colour

what: a nothic: a hunched, bony cyclops creature that was once a wizard, standing on two legs with its back bent almost double. Its head is turned to face the viewer, and it is a cyclops: it has exactly one eye, a single enormous round eyeball set in the very centre of its face, so big that it takes up most of the head, with a black slit pupil. There is no second eye, no nose and no eye sockets at the sides; below the one big eye is only a wide mouth of needle teeth. Its arms are long and thin and end in long hooked claws, and a row of short spines runs down its bent back.
colours: mottled slate grey-blue leathery skin, one enormous sickly yellow eye with a black slit pupil, dirty ivory claws and spines, a faded dark red rag of robe.
wears: It wears only the torn remains of a wizard's robe: a faded dark red rag belted round its waist and hanging to its knees.
holds: Both clawed hands are empty and it holds nothing. It has no staff and no weapon.
pose: It creeps forward on two bent legs with its back hunched, its face turned straight towards the viewer so the one central eye stares out of the picture, both clawed hands raised and reaching, mouth open in a giggle.
must_show: a cyclops: exactly one enormous eye in the centre of the face
hunched bony body on two legs
long hooked claws, empty hands
torn rag of a robe
spines down the back

what: an otyugh: a blind, faceless rubbish-eating monster. Its body is one fat round ball of wrinkled, warty, mud-brown hide as big as an ox, with no head, no neck, no face and no arms. The entire front of the ball is a single enormous gaping mouth, as wide as the body itself, ringed with thick lips and long jagged yellow teeth, with a dark red throat inside; there is nothing else on the front of the body, only the mouth. The ball rests low on exactly three short thick stumpy legs with flat round feet. Two long, boneless, snaking tentacles of warty brown hide grow from the left and right sides of the ball, each ending in a broad flat leaf-shaped pad of brown flesh studded with thorns. One thin bendy stalk of brown flesh rises from the top of the ball, and at its tip sit three small orange eyeballs in a cluster: these are the only eyes the creature has.
colours: wrinkled warty mud-brown and dirty grey-brown animal hide with darker brown blotches, yellowed teeth, a dull red mouth, three small orange eyes.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: Its two tentacles are empty and hold nothing.
pose: The round lump squats low on its three stumpy legs facing the viewer, mouth gaping wide. The two long tentacles snake outward and upward in S-curves to either side with their thorny pads held open, and the thin eye-stalk bends forward from the top to look at the viewer.
must_show: a round body whose whole front is one enormous toothed mouth
two long boneless tentacles ending in thorny pads
a bendy stalk on top carrying the only eyes
short stumpy legs, squatting low
warty mud-brown hide, no eyes on the body
must_not_show: leaves, vines or a plant stem
rigid spike or horn on top
rubbish heap or bones under it

what: a grell: a floating bare brain as wide as a wagon wheel. The whole body is the brain: a big rounded lump of soft, wet, wrinkled brain flesh covered in deep winding folds and grooves, with no skull and no skin over it. It is not a bird and has no head: it has no eyes, no eye sockets, no face and no feathers. A large hooked yellow beak, like the beak alone cut from a parrot, sticks straight out of the bare brain flesh low down at the front, with nothing but smooth wrinkled brain above it. From the underside of the brain hang ten long, thick, smooth, ropy tentacles, each ending in a small barbed tip.
colours: wet pale grey and ash-grey wrinkled brain flesh with darker charcoal grooves, a dull yellow-orange beak, slate-grey tentacles with pale undersides and ivory barbs.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: Its tentacles are empty and hold nothing.
pose: It floats in the upper half of the picture, turned to the left with its beak open, its tentacles hanging down and curling forward beneath it, two of them reaching ahead. It simply floats: nothing above it and nothing below it.
must_show: a floating wrinkled grey brain with folds and grooves
a hooked beak growing straight out of the brain
long thick tentacles hanging beneath
no eyes anywhere

what: a roper: a monster that is nothing but a stalagmite. Its whole body is one tall, thick, lumpy pillar of rough cave rock, taller than a man, widest at the bottom and narrowing to a blunt rounded tip, built up in uneven dripping layers like melted candle wax turned to stone. It has no head, no neck, no chest, no arms, no legs and no feet: only the rock pillar. Halfway up the pillar, set directly in the rock, is exactly one large round eye. Just below the eye a wide jagged crack in the rock is its mouth, full of long stone teeth. Six long, thick, heavy tentacles like ship's cables grow straight out of the rock, three from the left side and three from the right.
colours: rough grey-brown and sandy tan cave rock with darker brown cracks, one bright yellow eye with a black slit pupil, a dark red mouth, ivory teeth, six pale yellowish-tan tentacles.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: Its six tentacles are empty and hold nothing.
pose: The rock pillar is upright and still, facing the viewer, its mouth open, while its six thick tentacles lash outward and upward in curves to both sides. The pillar has a clean flat bottom edge with nothing under it.
must_show: a lumpy stalagmite pillar of rock, the whole body
exactly one large yellow eye set in the rock
a wide toothed mouth in the rock
thick tentacles whipping out from both sides
no arms, no legs
must_not_show: cave floor or rocks around it

what: a cloaker: a flying creature shaped like a manta ray and like a black cloak spread open. Its body is one broad, flat, leathery sheet with two wide pointed wing-flaps. Seen from its underside, the middle of the sheet has a wide mouth full of pointed white teeth with two round glowing red eyes just above it. Two curved bone claws like a cloak's clasp stick up from the top edge, and a long, thick, whip-like tail hangs from the bottom edge.
colours: black and deep charcoal leathery outer hide, a bone-white and pale grey underside, two red eyes, white teeth, ivory claw hooks, a black tail.
wears: It wears nothing; it only looks like a cloak.
holds: It has no hands and holds nothing.
pose: It swoops straight at the viewer with both wing-flaps spread wide and curling forward at the tips to wrap around, mouth open, the thick tail lashing out to one side. It flies in empty space.
must_show: a flat manta-ray body like a spread black cloak
pale underside with a toothed mouth
two red eyes
a long thick tail
two bone claw hooks at the top edge

what: a lurker above: a broad, flat creature like a living blanket: one wide, thin, rounded-square sheet of flesh with four rounded corners, no head, no tail and no eyes. We see its underside as it drops on us. The middle of the underside is pale flesh, ribbed with thick muscle ridges that fan out from a small round sucker mouth in the centre like the folds of an umbrella. All the way round the sheet runs a wide, thick border of its upper hide folding over the edge: rough, lumpy, cracked grey cave rock with small stubby stone nubs, exactly like a broken slab of cave ceiling.
colours: a wide border of rough slate-grey and charcoal-grey cracked rock, a pale grey-cream ribbed underside, a small dark mouth. No blue anywhere.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It has no hands and holds nothing.
pose: It is dropping flat towards the viewer, seen from directly underneath, spread out wide like a falling blanket, with its four rounded corners and rocky border curling down and inward to wrap. It falls through empty space with no ceiling shown.
must_show: a broad flat blanket of a creature, spread wide, seen from underneath
a wide border of rough cracked grey rock all round the edge
pale ribbed underside with a small central mouth
edges curling in to wrap
no tail and no eyes
must_not_show: legs or a body hanging underneath

what: a trapper: a flat creature that lies on the floor pretending to be the floor. It is one thick square sheet of flesh whose top surface is patterned exactly like a pavement of square sandy flagstones with dark joints between them. In the middle of the sheet it has raised a lump shaped like a small wooden treasure chest, as bait. The underside of the sheet is smooth pale flesh.
colours: sandy tan and warm yellow-brown flagstone pattern with dark brown joints, a pale cream-pink underside, a brown bait chest with dull gold bands.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It has no hands and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from above at an angle, it is springing its trap: all four corners of the square sheet are lifting and curling up and inward like a closing fist, showing the pale underside on the raised corners, with the chest-shaped lump still sitting in the middle. It is one clean-edged shape alone in empty space.
must_show: a square sheet patterned like sandy flagstones
corners curling up and inward
a chest-shaped lump in the middle
pale underside showing on the lifted corners
must_not_show: open chest with teeth and a tongue
dungeon room or walls around it

what: a lahamu: a primordial thing of river mud from the Babylonian creation story, with no fixed shape. It is a tall, shapeless, slumping heap of wet, glistening, dripping clay, like a mudslide standing up, with no head, no neck, no shoulders, no chest, no arms and no legs. It is not a statue and not a person. From the heap rise four thick ropes of the same wet clay, like fat blind worms with blunt rounded ends, twisting and looping. Near the top of the heap are its only features: two deep round pits with a small amber light glowing in each, and below them a crooked sagging gash for a mouth. Rows of small wedge-shaped marks are pressed into the clay lower down.
colours: wet red-brown river clay with glossy highlights, streaks of pale grey silt, small amber eye lights.
wears: It is made of clay and wears nothing.
holds: It has no hands; its clay coils are empty and hold nothing.
pose: The heap of mud surges forward and upward like a breaking wave, slumping and dripping, two thick clay ropes raised high and curling over to crush, two more looping out at its sides, the two amber eye-pits glaring down at the viewer. The heap has a clean lower edge.
must_show: a shapeless slumping heap of wet red-brown clay
thick blunt clay ropes rising from it
two amber eye lights in pits and a gash of a mouth, nothing more of a face
the whole creature the same wet dripping clay
must_not_show: water splash or pool under it

what: an abyssal champion: a tall, lean, powerful demon duellist standing on two legs, with dark crimson skin, a hard narrow face, pointed ears, burning orange eyes and two short horns curving back from his brow. He has the realistic proportions of a tall adult man, about eight heads tall, with no wings.
colours: dark crimson-red skin, blackened iron plate armour with dull brass edging, a tattered black half-cape, a sword blade wrapped in orange and yellow flame.
wears: He wears a duellist's fighting armour: a blackened iron breastplate, one large spiked shoulder plate on his left shoulder, iron gauntlets and greaves, and a tattered black half-cape hanging from the left shoulder. His head is bare.
holds: He holds exactly one long, broad, straight sword in his right hand, its whole blade burning with orange flame that stays on the blade. His left hand is empty, an open hand held behind his back.
pose: He stands tall on two legs in a fencer's salute, feet together, the burning sword raised upright in front of his face with the blade pointing straight up, left hand behind his back, a cold smile.
must_show: demon swordsman: crimson skin, short horns
blackened plate armour and a half-cape
exactly one sword with a burning blade, raised upright in salute
left hand empty
no wings
must_not_show: column of flame hiding the body

what: an abyssal hound: a real hunting dog on four legs, lean and very long in the leg like a great greyhound or wolfhound, with a deep chest, a narrow waist, a long muzzle, pricked ears and a long thin tail. Its short coat is black as burnt wood, and thin glowing ember-orange cracks run along its ribs and legs. Its eyes are small orange coals and a little flame licks out between its teeth.
colours: charcoal-black coat with thin glowing ember-orange cracks, orange eyes, white fangs, a small orange and yellow flame at the mouth.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it runs flat out to the left on four legs in a full stretched gallop, front legs reaching, back legs kicked out behind, jaws open with the small flame between its teeth.
must_show: a lean long-legged black dog on four legs
glowing ember cracks in the coat
a small flame at the mouth
running, seen from the side

what: an abyssal overlord: a demon king, the ruler of a whole layer of the pit, standing on two legs. He is massive and broad, with coal-black skin split by glowing molten-orange cracks, a heavy horned head with burning yellow eyes, and two great leathery bat wings spread behind his shoulders. Four long horns sweep up from his head, and between them sits a tall jagged crown of black iron.
colours: coal-black skin with glowing molten-orange cracks, black leathery wings with dark red membranes, a black iron crown and black iron armour edged in gold, a long dark crimson royal mantle, yellow eyes.
wears: He wears a tall jagged black iron crown, a wide collar and shoulder plates of black iron edged in gold, heavy gold arm-rings, a belt of gold skulls, and a long dark crimson mantle hanging from his shoulders to the ground.
holds: Both hands are empty. His right fist is raised overhead, glowing molten orange like hot iron; his left hand is held open at his side, palm up, with a small flame burning in the palm and touching the hand. He has no weapon and no staff.
pose: He stands on two legs, feet planted wide, chest out, wings spread wide and high behind him, right fist raised to slam down, looking down at the viewer.
must_show: demon king: black skin with molten cracks, great horns
black iron crown
two large spread bat wings
royal mantle and gold ornaments
empty hands, one fist raised glowing
the most ornate and commanding of the abyssal demons

what: an abyssal behemoth: a colossal siege beast on four legs, built like a cross between a rhinoceros and a hippopotamus, with a vast barrel body, four legs like pillars, a short thick neck and a huge blunt head with a wide jaw and two short heavy tusks. Its whole body, head and legs included, is covered in thick overlapping slabs of scorched hide like burnt armour plates, with a dull red glow in the seams. A row of blunt bony knobs runs down its spine. Its tail is enormous: as thick as one of its legs where it joins the body, long, heavy and armour-plated like a crocodile's tail or a tree trunk, tapering only at the very end.
colours: scorched charcoal-grey and soot-black plated hide with dull red-orange glowing seams, ash-grey tusks and knobs, small red eyes, a short jet of orange and yellow fire.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it stamps forward to the left on four thick legs, one front leg lifted to crush, head lowered, jaws open with a short thick jet of fire coming straight out of its mouth, its huge thick tail swung up and out behind it.
must_show: a massive four-legged beast, rhinoceros-heavy
scorched armour-plate hide over the whole body and head
glowing red seams
a very thick heavy plated tail, like a crocodile's
a short jet of fire from the mouth
must_not_show: long nose horn like a rhinoceros

what: an abyssal mimic: a demon wearing the shape of a heap of treasure, caught in the moment it shows its real self. The lower part is a heaped pile of gold coins with a jewelled goblet and a gold crown lying on it. The heap has split open across the middle into one huge wide mouth with long curved fangs above and below, and inside the mouth and oozing between the coins is glossy black tar-like flesh. Two thick black tar tentacles rise from the heap, each still half covered in sliding gold coins. Two burning orange eyes glare from the black flesh above the mouth.
colours: bright yellow gold coins and treasure, glossy tar-black flesh, ivory fangs, a dark red mouth, two ember-orange eyes.
wears: It wears nothing; the gold is its own disguised skin.
holds: Its two tar tentacles are empty and hold nothing.
pose: It lunges forward and upward out of the gold heap with its fanged mouth gaping, both black tentacles raised and spread to embrace, coins spilling down its sides. The heap is one compact lump with a clean lower edge.
must_show: a heap of gold coins
a huge fanged mouth splitting the heap
glossy black tar flesh and two black tentacles
two ember-orange eyes
gold and black together in one body
must_not_show: coins scattered loose across the floor

what: an abyssal locust, as described in the Book of Revelation: a giant locust the size of a war-horse. It has a real locust's body: a long segmented abdomen, six jointed insect legs with the two big folded jumping legs at the back, and two pairs of long narrow wings. In place of an insect head it has a man's stern bearded face with long flowing black hair and a snarling mouth of lion's fangs. Its abdomen ends in a curled scorpion's tail with a large sting.
colours: bronze-brown and dark tan locust shell, a dull iron-grey breastplate, a bright gold crown, long black hair, a pale tan human face, smoky amber wings, a black scorpion sting.
wears: It wears a small gold crown on its head and an iron breastplate strapped round its chest like a war-horse's armour.
holds: It stands on its six insect legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, it rears with its front pair of legs lifted off the ground, wings raised and spread above its back, scorpion tail arched high over its body, fanged mouth open.
must_show: a locust body with six insect legs and big jumping back legs
a man's face with long hair
gold crown
iron breastplate
curled scorpion tail with a sting
insect wings
must_not_show: centaur with a human torso and arms

what: a werewolf alpha: a towering wolf-man standing upright on two legs, the old pack leader. He has a full wolf's head with a long muzzle, tall ears and bared fangs, a deep chest, long powerful arms ending in big black claws, and wolf's hind legs with paws. Thick shaggy wolf fur covers every part of him: his chest, belly, shoulders, arms and hands are all furred, with no bare skin showing anywhere. A heavy silver-white mane hangs round his neck and down his chest, an old scar crosses his muzzle and one ear is torn.
colours: dark charcoal-grey and black shaggy fur over the whole body, a silver-white mane and chest ruff, black claws, yellow-amber eyes, white fangs, torn dark brown leather trousers.
wears: He wears only the torn remains of dark brown leather trousers, ragged at the knee, and a broken leather belt. No shirt, no armour.
holds: Both clawed hands are empty and he holds nothing.
pose: He stands upright on two legs with his feet apart, knees bent, head thrown back and muzzle pointed at the sky in a howl, both arms spread wide and low with claws open.
must_show: upright wolf-man on two legs with a wolf's head
shaggy dark grey fur over the chest, belly and arms
silver-white mane
empty clawed hands
head thrown back howling
torn trousers
must_not_show: blue or purple skin or fur

what: a dire wolf alpha: a real wolf on four legs, far heavier than any ordinary wolf, as tall as a pony at the shoulder, with a massive broad head, thick bone-cracking jaws, a deep chest, heavy shoulders and a thick shaggy neck ruff. Its coat is black and grey like a timber wolf in winter, with no brown in it. Its muzzle is grizzled white and marked by three old claw scars, and one fang is longer than the other.
colours: jet-black fur along the back, neck and tail, iron-grey and silver-grey flanks, shoulders and legs, a pale grey-white throat and belly, a grizzled white muzzle, amber eyes, white fangs. No brown, tan, orange or yellow fur anywhere.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, it stalks forward on four legs with its head low, hackles raised along its back, lips curled back from its fangs in a snarl, tail held straight out.
must_show: a real wolf on four legs, seen from the side
heavy build: broad head, thick neck ruff, deep chest
black back with grey flanks and legs, no brown
scarred grizzled white muzzle
snarling, hackles raised

what: a chimera alpha, the three-part monster of Greek myth as Homer describes it, old and grown huge. Front part: the body of a great lion on four legs, with a lion's head at the front framed by a heavy dark mane, and old scars across the shoulder. Middle part: from the middle of its back, behind the mane, grows the neck and head of a white goat, with a beard and two long, thick, ridged black horns curving back; the goat faces forward, the same way as the lion. Rear part: it has no lion's tail. Where the tail should be, a thick green serpent grows out of the lion's rump, arching up and backward away from the body, and ends in a snake's head with open jaws that faces backward. The serpent is only at the rear and does not touch or wrap around the goat.
colours: tawny gold lion fur, a dark brown-black mane, a grey-white goat head and neck with black horns, an emerald-green scaled serpent tail with a pale yellow belly, orange and yellow fire.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, the lion facing left, it strides forward on four lion legs with one front paw raised, claws out. On the left, the lion head roars with fangs bared. In the middle, the goat head on its back breathes a short thick tongue of fire forward over the lion's mane. On the right, the serpent tail arches up from the rump with its snake head hissing towards the right edge of the picture.
must_show: a lion's body on four legs with a maned lion head
a horned white goat's head rising from the middle of the back
a green serpent growing from the rump as the tail, snake head facing backward
a short tongue of fire from the goat's mouth
three clearly separate heads: lion at the front, goat in the middle, snake at the rear
must_not_show: three heads side by side on one neck

what: an adult roc, the giant bird of the Sinbad stories and Marco Polo's travels, big enough to carry off an elephant. It is drawn as a real eagle in full adult plumage with massive, heavy proportions: a thick neck, a deep chest, a huge hooked beak, very broad wings with long fingered feathers at the tips, a fan tail, and thick scaly legs ending in enormous curved talons. To show how vast the bird is, it carries a whole elephant in its talons: a complete small grey elephant with trunk, tusks, big ears and four legs, gripped round the body and dangling under the bird, looking tiny next to it, about one quarter of the bird's size.
colours: dark golden-brown body and wing feathers with paler tan edges, a white head and neck, a bright yellow hooked beak, yellow scaly legs, black talons, fierce amber eyes, a plain stone-grey elephant with ivory tusks.
wears: It is a bird and wears nothing.
holds: Its two talons together grip exactly one small grey elephant round the body. It carries nothing else.
pose: It is flying to the left, seen from the side and a little below, with both great wings raised high and spread wide above its back, beak open in a scream, both legs stretched down beneath it clutching the small elephant, which hangs directly under the bird's body and touches it. It flies in empty space.
must_show: a giant eagle with both wings spread wide
golden-brown plumage with a white head
huge hooked yellow beak
one small grey elephant gripped in its talons, clearly an elephant
the elephant much smaller than the bird
must_not_show: elephant as big as the bird
bird standing on the elephant's back on the ground
perching on a rock or branch
